PROCUREMENT POLICY
Policy Code: PRC-005
Title: Services and Contracts
Version: 1.1
Effective Date: 2025-01-01
Category: contracts
Company: Northwind Industrial Co.
1. Contract Review
1.1 Contracts with a total value above USD 10,000 require legal review before signature.
1.2 Contracts must state the effective date, the end date, the total value and the
    payment terms.
2. Payment Terms
2.1 Payment terms must be at least net 30 days.
2.2 Payment terms longer than net 60 days require finance director approval.
2.3 Advance payments must not exceed 30 percent of the contract value.
3. Services
3.1 Consulting engagements must define deliverables and an acceptance procedure.
3.2 Services must not begin before the contract is signed by both parties.
SYNTHETIC DATA - fictional company and vendors, not a real document
